facts.title: Vietnam peace agreement — 1973
facts.text: A peace agreement for Vietnam was signed on 27 January 1973; the war continued after the settlement and ended effectively in 1975.

facts.title: Montreal Protocol and CFCs
facts.text: The Montreal Protocol provided a framework to phase out ozone-depleting substances, including chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs).

facts.title: First Opium War
facts.text: The First Opium War was between Great Britain and China from 1839 to 1842.

facts.title: Battle of Waterloo
facts.text: The Battle of Waterloo was fought on 18 June 1815.

facts.title: Korean War — outbreak
facts.text: War broke out on the Korean peninsula on 25 June 1950.

facts.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
facts.text: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in Paris on 10 December 1948.

facts.title: Atlantic Charter
facts.text: The Atlantic Charter was a joint declaration released by U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill on 14 August 1941.
